names.note: The nominative the day page's own `/name/` link carries in its `title`, «Модест Римский, Пестун, мч.», with the rank abbreviation left off and both epithets kept — Пестун is the foster-father or tutor the life makes him, and it is what tells him from the three other Modestus folders this corpus holds. The day's own line declines the three together, «Мчч. Вита , Модеста и Крискентии (ок. 303).» `fk.mjs` on this form returned NONE before the write; the other holders of the bare name are `modestus-of-jerusalem`, `modestus-companion-of-julian` and `modestus-companion-of-zoticus`, and none of them is this man.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru: «Страдания святых мучеников Вита, Модеста и Крискентии совершились около 303 года», and the day line prints «(ок. 303)». The page's own «около» is kept in the display, and it gives no year of birth.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 16 мая ст. ст. — «Мчч. Вита , Модеста и Крискентии (ок. 303).»

attestations.note: A line that names three people is three folders, per BRIEF.md §4, and the single life page behind all three names each of them and says what each did. The page's own «Дни памяти» line gives «16 мая , 15 июня»; the day page that printed him is 16 мая, so the June day is recorded here and he does not render on it. The day page prints no hymn for the three. azbyka.ru was not read.
